description: Two buttons drawn as a pair, side by side at the same size, whose translations are not the same length. Each fitted on its own settles at a slightly different point size - the German settings page shipped 9.35 beside 9.44 - and a pair of buttons at almost but not quite the same size reads as a mistake rather than as a decision. The row is sized as a set early on; nothing put the sizes back together after the later passes had fitted each button's own caption.
